mask: ellipse; target=[left,top,width,height]; scale and offset=[x,y] register each existing eye curve inside the current bead contour on the 1024 body canvas. Curve-only local scale keeps the complete eyelid arc in the narrow mask; no face rectangle, no full-body expression swap
expressionNote: Existing app frames visually compared with the current 4096 canonical expressions. Lossy WebP derivations are not byte-identical to their PNG sources. Only the existing eye/lens contours are clipped at runtime; body pixels and complete outer alpha stay in the fixed current base.
visualCheck: Chrome, Paper #fbf7f0 and Ink #2b2320, 88px and 176px: open/closed and repeating eye-only layer checked on 2026-09-11. Mongle bead edge mask corrected after visual review. This checks the chosen mask geometry; integration Expo playback is a separate check.
rasterBoundary: CSS elliptical clipping may antialias the immediate subpixel boundary. No blur, whole-face blend, original asset mutation or new generated expression.
